All 6 pages fetched live through the documented r.jina.ai proxy (direct HTML is a JS shell), HTTP 200, 5-21 KB of markdown each, and the "<n>. Spec Class (X Tier)" ranking block parsed. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 missing. Both documented parse hazards handled and re-confirmed present: Wowhead writes a HYPHENATED "(S-Tier)", which a naive [SABCDF][+-]? pattern reads as a non-existent "S-" band, and the tier separator must therefore accept a hyphen OR a space; the M+ DPS page's tier set correctly came out as A+/A/B/C with no phantom bands. Era-verified per title: all six read "Midnight Season 1", Devourer present. ZERO tier moves.

Archon's own lastUpdated advanced to 2026-08-03T12:00:00Z (the 08-02 runs read 08-01T12:00:00Z), so this is a genuinely NEW daily aggregate — and it still produced ZERO letter-tier moves, which is upstream stability rather than a stale fetch: the underlying numbers below did move.

Stored data is therefore correct but lagging; 6 days is still inside this requirement's maxAgeDays of 8 (raised 4 -> 8 on 2026-07-31), so nothing is red yet, but the upstream pipeline looks stalled rather than merely slow and it will breach the threshold in 2 more days.
